attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & NSS 77th Round: Marginal dryland oilseed cultivators in Chitradurga (Challakere/Hiriyur taluks), semi-arid rainfed conditions with high reliance on state welfare borewell packages.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka Ganga Kalyana query logs: Marginal SC farmers inquiring about individual borewell eligibility thresholds under Ambedkar Development Corporation.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Evaluates Ganga Kalyana Individual Route for SC category (Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Corporation); landholding of 2.0 acres satisfies plains acreage interval [1.5, 5.0]; family income of ₹1.2 lakh recorded; raw engine evaluates ELIGIBLE (GK_AMBEDKAR_INDIVIDUAL_ROUTE_VALID). CRITICAL GOVERNANCE SAFEGUARD: Official Ambedkar Corporation guidelines describe individual irrigation as applicable to lands adjacent to perennial water sources (rivers/streams/tanks), but S029 lacks recorded source-adjacency evidence; additionally, older district administration pages cite ₹1.5 lakh rural ceiling vs ₹2.0 lakh state ceiling. Pending field verification of source-adjacency and current Chitradurga district income order, governance decouples determination to Section B as REQUIRES_VERIFICATION without numerical scoring.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate Ganga Kalyana individual borewell route on marginal SC holding; enforce governance safeguard placing raw ELIGIBLE Ambedkar borewell in Section B pending source-adjacency and income-order verification.
unresolved_dependencies: Field verification of land parcel adjacency to a qualifying perennial water source (river/stream/tank) under Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Development Corporation individual irrigation guidelines
Chitradurga district administrative order confirming applicable rural family income ceiling (₹1.5 lakh vs ₹2.0 lakh order)
